title: Surcharge on Float-Downs of Relocked Rate Lock Commitments
content:
Relocked locks pay more to float down. On a **Rate Lock Commitment**, a lock that has been relocked carries a surcharge on its float-down. The surcharge is added to the float-down fee points, which are never below zero and are rounded to three decimal places. The count is the relock fee entries on the lock's pricing ledger.

**Rule.**

- When the lock carries two or more relock fee entries, the two-relock surcharge of **0.25** points is added.
- When it carries exactly one, the one-relock surcharge of **0.125** points is added.
- Otherwise none is added.

| Relock fee entries on the lock | Surcharge (points) |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 0.125 |
| 2 or more | 0.25 |

*Hypothetical case:* a Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock relocked twice, with both relock fee entries booked, adds 0.25 points to its float-down fee points.
